description:
Windows desktop app for downloading videos via yt-dlp, with a bundled FFmpeg for post-processing.

VideoDownloader is a Windows desktop app for downloading videos via yt-dlp, with a bundled custom FFmpeg for merging and remuxing. Paste a link or a list of links, pick a video/audio quality or let it auto-select the best available, and queue batch downloads with configurable concurrency, per-job progress, and cancel support. Every attempt is logged to a searchable download history with one-click redownload. Available in English and Polish, with Light/Dark/System UI themes.
Fixes
- Every download failed with [Errno 13] Permission denied: 'C:\Program Files\APPIT\VideoDownloader\tmp….tmp' when the app was installed with the MSI (or via winget) and started from the Start Menu. yt-dlp was writing its temporary format-check files into the install folder, which normal users can't write to. It now uses your user temp folder (%TEMP%).
Full changelog: v0.7.2...v0.7.3
